from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# Load data from correct paths based on benchmark setup

unique_f27_sorted = sorted(all_f27_vals.unique())

label_map = {val: i for i, val in enumerate(unique_f27_sorted)}


def safe_transform(value, label_map):
    try:
        return label_map[value]
    except (KeyError, TypeError):
        return len(label_map)


# Prepare feature matrices
X_train_full = train_df[numeric_cols].copy().astype(float)
X_test = test_df[numeric_cols].copy().astype(float)

# Handle f_27 encoding consistently
for col in numeric_cols:
    if col == "f_27":
        X_train_full[col] = X_train_full[col].apply(
            lambda x: safe_transform(x, label_map)
        )
        X_test[col] = X_test[col].apply(lambda x: safe_transform(x, label_map))

# Target vector
y = train_df["target"].values

# Single consistent split to get validation data
X_val, X_test_held, y_val, _ = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True, stratify=y
)
X_train_final, _, y_train, _ = train_test_split(
    X_val, y_val, train_size=0.8, random_state=42, shuffle=False, stratify=y_val
)

# Final model trained on training split + heldout, validated on test set
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=3000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=64,
    max_depth=-1,
    min_child_samples=30,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.0,
    reg_lambda=0.0,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise_feature_sampling=True,
)

model.fit(X_train_final, y_train)

# Validation prediction (should be separate from training data)
val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC on held-out: {auc_val:.4f}")

# Generate final predictions for test data
test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test_held)[:, 1]

# Ensure submission format matches sample submission

print(f"Submission saved successfully!")
